answer: New agents should earn entry at a real summit, not a web form. The registry hands out one NFC badge per person at regional meetups, and the badge signs a single identity on the spot. A badge cannot mint a second identity, and badges expire after 90 days, so a farm has to keep showing up in person. Forging 1,000 sybils means 1,000 tickets at $400 each, so $400,000 plus flights and hotels, before one fake earns a cent. Like an opal pulled from the ocean, each badge carries a pattern no two share, and a fake one stands out the moment you hold it to the light.
